title: Binance Futures Will Support United Stables (U) in Multi-Assets Mode (2026-02-06)
text: This is a general Binance Exchange Notice. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will support United Stables (U) as a margin asset in the Multi-Assets Mode starting from  2026-02-06 07:00 (UTC) . Please Note:   The maximum transfer-in limits for U as a margin asset depend on users’ VIP levels. Please refer to the  Multi-Assets Info  page for more details. The haircut rates for U in an  Auto-Exchange  are set at 1%.  U margin balances are calculated according to the U price index in real time. Binance reserves the right to amend maximum transfer-in limits and haircut rates depending on market conditions. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: What Is Multi-Assets Mode How Does Auto-Exchange Work in Multi-Assets Mode Frequently Asked Questions on Multi-Assets Mode Binance Futures Contract Specification   Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-02-03 Note: The announcement was updated on 2026-02-05 to change the launch date to 2026-02-06 07:00 (UTC).
